# Extra Space Storage

> Extra Space Storage operates 4,000+ self-storage facilities across 43 states, offering secure climate-controlled units with contact-free rentals and online search tools.

Extra Space Storage is a nationwide self-storage provider with a comprehensive network of facilities. The platform enables customers to search for storage units by location, compare amenities, and manage rentals through digital channels.
